prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1002; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision occurred?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Houston, Texas. I had a green light and was heading straight through.

Q: What direction were you traveling, and what did you see before impact?

A: I was going east. Traffic on the cross street was stopped at the light, and I didn't expect anyone to run it. A car came from my left side and hit the passenger door.

Q: How fast do you estimate you were going?

A: Maybe thirty-five miles an hour, the posted limit. I was not speeding.

Q: Did you brake or swerve before the impact?

A: I hit the brakes as soon as I saw the car, but there wasn't enough room to stop. I didn't have time to swerve.

Q: Were there any witnesses or traffic cameras you are aware of?

A: A man was standing on the corner, and I think a delivery driver stopped afterward. I don't know if there are cameras.

Q: Where did you feel the injury, and when did you first notice it?

A: My left wrist hurt right away. My hand hit the steering wheel and the airbag came out. At the hospital they told me the wrist was fractured, and I've been wearing a splint since.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment at the scene or afterward?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. I've had follow-up visits with an orthopedic doctor and I have another appointment scheduled.

Q: Is there anything else you want to add about the collision?

A: Only that I was following the rules and the other driver ran the red light. That's all I have.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
